en: And, on account of your insults, you've earned yourself more than just defeat.
I vow I will crush you so badly, you'll never raise another fist again!
Prepare to be broken, Kazuma Kiryuuu!!!
Graaaaagh! *gasp* Agh....
Why!? Why does victory elude us!?
We have dedicated our lives to becoming the absolute paragon of strength, generation upon generation!
We cannot let the Amon Clan fall here! How is this one man able to bring us to our knees!?
If all you thirst for is power, then true strength will never be yours.
What's important is the reason you fight. If it holds any weight, no one will stand a chance against you.
But if you hold onto things like pride or revenge, you'll only end up beaten every time. Like now.
...How could we have lost to one so naive?
No! This is not the end! The Amon Clan will never accept defeat!
Fine. Come at me as many times as you need until you realize the truth.
Grr... You may think you have the upper hand, but just you wait.
We will have our revenge another day, Kazuma Kiryu! Mark my words!
Looks like another glorious victory, huh?
No doubt they'll be back again, stronger than ever.
Like ya said, Kiryu, we'll just have to keep knockin' 'em down.
Uh, does that mean I'm all caught up in this too, now?
Yep. You better get your act together, and stop that snivelin'.
Aww, man... I've had it with this.
You got <Color:8>Amon's Sunglasses<Color:Default>.
(I can't just up and drag someone into a battle with the Amon...)
(Is that someone Uncle Kaz knows? He looks like the type of guy I should stay away from.)
Are you all prepared? Make sure you haven't forgotten anything... including your last will.
I'm good to go.
Ready as I'll ever be.
I am definitely not ready... but screw it, let's do it.
Okay then. Right this way.
Actually, I need a little more time.
Sorry, but I'm gonna need a bit more time.
Nope. Gimme some time, will ya?
Hold on. I'm not even close to ready yet.
I'll be waiting here, then. Notify me when you're ready.
So this is the Komaki dojo, huh?
(That's Sosuke.)
(I guess he's going to face off with his grandfather. Maybe I'll check it out when I have time.)
You seem kind of down.
Huh? What're you doing here, old man?
Got something to take care of here in town. I saw you out front, so I thought I'd swing by.
Oh. Well, my gramps is out. I've been cooling my heels waiting.
Where the hell is that old coot, anyway?
Master, that was some seriously good shopping!
Indeed. Who'd have thought we'd be able to acquire the exact same type of long boots?
Oh, Kiryu, my most cherished of students! I see you've returned to Kamurocho.
Long time no see, old man. Glad to see you're doing good.
Heh, don't ever underestimate me. I haven't given away an inch to old age.
You seem to be doing well, too. Now, to address the elephant in the room.
Sosuke... This is quite a surprise.
Hey, Gramps.
It's been some time since you ended your training. I trust you've been doing well?
Sure, whatever.
I see you still have that smart mouth of yours. Still, to see my grandson after so long is rather nice, I must say.
Now that we're all here, let's break bread together this evening.
Sorry, Gramps, but I'm not here to play around.
I don't get you. How can you live like this, like you don't have a care in the world?
I mean this dojo! You got all sorts of students learning the Komaki style like it was some kind of fitness class!
I've been out there fighting day in and day out trying to prove that the Komaki style is the ultimate martial art!
I promised myself I was going to be the strongest and make something of myself. I didn't want to be a disappointment to my parents anymore.
But you ignore me, you ignore them, and you just do whatever you feel like.
Sosuke...
I've always wanted to tell you to your face, Gramps. Tell you that I don't accept your choice to act like some kind of fitness teacher.
So when I ran into this student of yours, I decided I was going to smash his face in.
But he kicked my ass. Didn't think he'd be that good. It's like he's got something deep inside him that makes him stronger.
But you, Gramps! I'll never accept the choice you made! I'm going to show you you're wrong!
I won't stand by and watch you teach the Komaki style to a bunch of homeless fools like it's some fitness class! It's better than that!
I challenge you to a fight. If I win...
You close this dojo and never use the Komaki style again.
Keep out of this, old man. It's between my gramps and me.
Don't you chicken out on me, Gramps. I give you my word that if I lose, I'll do whatever you say.
Very well. I accept your challenge.
Kiryu, I'm sorry, but I'll have to ask you to take the rest of my students and leave. This fight is between my grandson and me.
I've already made up my mind.
Hey, old man. Or should I call you Kiryu?
Sosuke, you're back.
Yeah, thought I'd stick around for a while. You know, start over and whatnot.
After that first fight, I had a chance to cool down. But that old geezer still stuck in my craw, so I fought him again... and lost again.
I finally realized that there was no way I was going to beat my gramps like I am now.
So I decided to train under him again. I want to learn everything I can from him.
He has a good foundation. Very intuitive, very agile.
I've no doubt that he will best me someday if he can master his soul, technique, and body.
Duh, of course I will. Don't be dumb.
Seems his mouth is still as big as ever.
I really have to thank you, old man. Thanks for pushing me to come here.
But to be honest, I haven't taught you all my moves. There was one I thought might help you beat me, so I left it out of your training.
It's an advanced form of the Komaki Tiger Drop. The secret is in striking at the perfect moment.
You see? Get the timing right and the chance of landing a counter goes way up.
Yeah, I can see how that'd be effective.
You learned <Color:9>Max Komaki Tiger Drop<Color:Default>.
Now I've taught you all I know. Put it to good use in your battles to come. I'm sure there will be plenty. Just don't get yourself killed.
Heh, thanks.
Kiryu. I, too, have something to teach you.
You do?
Yes, well, it's not like I've been sitting here twiddling my thumbs. I discovered a secret.
The secret to maintaining my power at this advanced age. You might call it a breakthrough.
A breakthrough?
That's right, but the required training is not without risks. Make sure you are fully prepared before you proceed.
And if you know of another who needs to master my secrets, I'd be happy to help. Just tell them to come see me here.
But only if they are worthy, that is.
Got it. I'll return when I'm ready.
Say, about that money I owe you.
Here.
I didn't rob anyone if that's what you mean. I earned it at my part-time job.
If I'd known how easy it was to make 30,000 yen, I'd never have borrowed it from you.
Hah.
Even so, um...
Thanks...
What!? I paid you back, didn't I!?
Go talk to my gramps if you need something.
It seems you have failed to break through the walls keeping you from your true potential.
Nevertheless, I believe you are worthy of my final secret. Come again when you're ready.
Ah, well done!
Now you will discover the deep well of potential inside you.
<Color:9>You have experienced a breakthrough.<Color:Default>
Your breakthrough has removed the level cap. You can now progress up to level 25. You can also acquire new skills on the Abilities screen.
But do not rest on your laurels. I want you to keep polishing your skills.
Ah, Kiryu. Forgive me for chasing you off like that.
So it's over, I take it? Is Sosuke okay?
I merely knocked him out. He'll come to soon enough. But I must say, he put up a good fight.
Ever since he left your side, he's been working hard... in his own way.
Ordinarily, I'd say he deserved a good scolding, but when I think about all he's been through...
Heh, I guess even you have a heart, old man.
Hmph. I'm being serious here.
So why's Sosuke so desperate to be the best?
The boy's parents, that is to say my son and his wife, suffered much hardship.
Perhaps worst of all was the huge loan they were tricked into taking out.
Because of that, Sosuke was relentlessly bullied, and their family hit rock bottom.
At the time, I was in peak form, but I had no way to leverage my strength to help them.
So I did the only thing I could think of. I handed my life savings to my son and disappeared.
So that's how you became homeless. Does Sosuke know about this?
He had just graduated from middle school. After his family's trouble, he gave up on high school and left home. So he doesn't know.
His parents got the loan situation under control to some degree, but they still couldn't afford to further his education.
But Sosuke is better off not knowing all this. His grudge against me is a powerful force that fuels his ambition.
Maybe, but strength born of grudges and vengeance doesn't always turn out for the better.
That goes without saying. That's why he cannot best me the way he is now no matter how hard he tries.
He'll realize this on his own someday. And then, perhaps he'll truly grow as a person.
You know I've been awake for a while, right?
And now I've heard way more than I wanted to.
What the hell? This just makes me a dumbass kid.
I didn't want to hear how Gramps became homeless because he gave my parents everything he had.
Why couldn't you keep your mouth shut?
I can't even beat my own gramps in a fight. How do you think that makes me feel!?
Sosuke, I'm afraid the answers you seek won't be quick in coming.
But if you'd like, you're welcome to start your training over with me.
What do you think I should do, old man?
Hmm... I only have one piece of advice for you.
Think for yourself.
Haha... You old geezers are so damn cold. It's not even funny, man.
Gramps, you mind if I chill a while till I cool down a little?
Not at all. Take your time.
Sorry, I've just got a lot to think about.
He seems troubled.
He's at that age where we can no longer guide him. He'll have to figure it out himself.
It's a process of trial and error, but he'll find his true path in time.
Forgive me. I regret having to burden my pupil with family matters.
It's not a problem.
I have no doubt that Sosuke will return. Don't you be a stranger, either.
There is nothing more I can teach you, but don't forget to hone your skills each and every day.
Ah, welcome. Ready to attempt a major breakthrough?
I see. Well, come on back when you feel you're ready.
I don't think you are yet ready to reach new heights.
Achieving a major breakthrough is more than mere study and practice. First, you must push yourself to the limits of self-improvement.
You must reach level 20 before you can begin the training required for a breakthrough.
Excellent. The training itself is quite straightforward. Simply try to defeat me.
That's it?
Do not take this lightly. Besting me is no easy task.
But by battling one who has achieved true strength, you shall push yourself to the limit necessary for your own breakthrough.
The harder you push yourself, the better. While battling me should be enough, with Sosuke's help, we can accelerate the process.
So you want me to fight on your side, Gramps?
You must be mentally and physically prepared for this. Do you wish to proceed?
All right then, let us begin!
That's all I have to do?
Defeat you? That's really it?
Wait, that's it? Piece of cake!
Hm? Now this is an unexpected visitor.
I can tell you've seen a fair share of battles despite being of the fairer sex.
If you come seeking strength, I can try to teach you the secret.
Are you ready to attempt a major breakthrough?
Wait, I have to defeat you? How am I supposed to do that?
Are you not a female warrior of sorts? Have you not spent your days battling to reach the top?
Battling to reach the top? Um, you mean like dance battles?
Dance battles? I don't understand.
Aw, come on, Gramps. You know, dance competitions.
Oh, so you're a dancing girl?
Gramps, she's one of those tricked out street dancers.
I don't know about the tricked out part, but yes, I compete in dance competitions.
You know what that means, Gramps. It's time for you to bust a move.
Er, bust a move? You mean dance? Me?
You already told her you'd help her with her breakthrough training. And for her, that would be dancing.
